label: prop:cyclotomic-strand-doubling
title: Cyclotomic doubling identity: $\Phi_8(X) = \Phi_4(X^2)$
html:
Proposition. Cyclotomic doubling identity: \Phi_8(X) = \Phi_4(X^2)

Over \mathbb{Z}[X], the cyclotomic polynomials satisfy:

  \Phi_8(X) \;=\; \Phi_4(X^2).

Universal atomic-step cyclotomic. The Habiro elements for successive atomic-step pairs—from deuteron to helium—universally extract a \Phi_8^2 cyclotomic prefactor. The appearance of \Phi_8 precedes the mechanical m=8 Pochhammer boundary, confirming it as a structural interference signature amongst the Habiro coefficients themselves.

The prior hypothesis interpreting X \mapsto X^2 as a categorical strand-doubling map failed empirical tests. The substitution does not generate a powers-of-two cyclotomic tower for heavier nuclei. The algebraic identity remains valid, but the categorical mechanism producing the universal \Phi_8^2 signature remains open.
